constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: Animate the supplied photo: bring it to life with slow drifting motion.
The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet combining one large cinematic hero view with smaller turnaround and detail panels.
The top hero view shows an adult on a rain-slick rooftop or industrial catwalk, with metal railings, falling rain, and blurred city lights behind.

The adult has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, a scar through one eyebrow in the close-up, and wears a black high-collared tactical jacket, dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle row contains three full-body turnaround views and the bottom row contains four close-up detail panels, all against a dark neutral backdrop.
The lighting is low-key and high-contrast, with cool blue-gray tones, warm amber background lights, and softer directional studio light on the reference panels.
Fine rain streaks animate downward, city lights pulse and blur into soft bokeh, and a wet sheen slides along the metal railing.
A faint breath lifts the figure's shoulders and shifts the jacket collar in the hero view without altering the character's identity or the sheet layout.
The soundtrack is an invented quiet ambience of steady soft rain, faint wet-city hum, distant traffic wash, and a delicate metallic shimmer along the railing.

summary.text: A single continuous animatic preserves the complete supplied character reference sheet while adding restrained, slow drifting life to its rain, city lights, wet railing, and breathing figure.

description.text: The complete supplied character reference sheet remains one intact, continuously visible image, framed exactly as provided and filling the target frame without cropping, rearranging, or extracting any single panel. The composition keeps its stacked structure: a wide cinematic hero view across the top, a middle row of full-body turnaround views, and a lower row of close-up detail studies, with the dark neutral studio backdrop and the rain-slick rooftop setting held in their original spatial relationships. The adult character in black tactical gear stays at the center of attention, with short dark hair, a high-collared jacket, cargo trousers, and lace-up combat boots reading clearly at every scale.

Low-key, high-contrast light shapes the sheet: cool blue-gray ambience and warm amber practicals glow behind the hero figure, while soft directional studio light rakes across the turnaround panels and reveals the matte fabric, straps, buckles, and leather of the boots. In the hero view, the figure stands upright with arms relaxed at the sides, head turned slightly to the side; in the turnaround row, frontal, profile, and back views hold their measured spacing; in the detail row, the face, collar, hands, and boots remain crisp, evenly lit studies. Fine rain streaks drift down through the upper image; distant city lights pulse and soften into bokeh; a thin sheen of water slides along the metal railing.

The character's posture stays stable, but a faint breath subtly lifts the shoulders and shifts the jacket collar, giving the still image a restrained sense of life. The existing panel lettering and labels remain fully legible and exactly in place, and no new typography, panel, character, or location is introduced. The palette of near-black, charcoal, slate blue, cool gray, and warm amber remains unchanged, with the cool shadows and warm highlights preserved. Motion is continuous and gentle rather than eventful: rain keeps falling, light shimmers, water creeps along the railing, and the figure breathes, while the full reference-sheet presentation holds steady and unbroken for the entire duration.

The image's own boundaries and internal borders stay fixed, so the eye can move from the widescreen hero image to the smaller turnaround and detail studies without any re-layout. The metal railing occupies the foreground plane in the hero section, with the city beyond falling into soft, layered bokeh; the character's silhouette remains dark and clean against those lights. The jacket's high collar sits close to the jaw, the straps and buckles catch small highlights, the cargo trousers break over the boots, and the laced footwear reads with a dull leather sheen. In the neutral reference panels, the figure's slim athletic build and short undercut with a small topknot remain legible from front, side, and back, while the close-up panels preserve the scar through one eyebrow, the texture of the collar, the relaxed hands, and the sturdy boots. The rain and city shimmer are restrained, never overtaking the sheet, and the warm amber points of light stay balanced against the cool blue-gray shadows. The overall effect is a quiet, breathing animatic of the original reference sheet rather than a newly staged scene.

The entire multi-panel character reference sheet appears exactly as supplied, with the wide hero view at the top, the three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and the four close-up detail studies along the bottom; all existing panel lettering, labels, spacing, and background elements remain in place.
Steady soft rain, a faint wet-city hum, distant traffic wash, and a delicate metallic shimmer along the railing establish a quiet, close ambience.
Rain streaks continue falling through the hero view, and the blurred city lights behind the railing pulse gently, their bokeh softening and brightening in slow waves.
A thin film of water slides along the metal railing, catching cool blue-gray and warm amber reflections as it moves.
The adult figure in the hero view draws a faint breath; the shoulders lift slightly and the jacket collar shifts, while the posture and identity remain unchanged.

soundscape: Steady soft rain, faint wet-city hum, distant traffic wash, and a delicate metallic shimmer along the railing.
